title: MindAgent | AI-Powered Multi-Agent Productivity Platform
description: A full-stack agentic AI platform where users interact with specialized AI Agents to generate content, analyze data, understand images, and chat with an intelligent assistant. Built with Next.js 15 and Express.js, it features streaming SSE responses, real-time conversation memory, multi-file analysis with interactive charts, and a polished responsive UI. The architecture uses a provider-agnostic AI abstraction layer, JWT authentication with Google OAuth, and a MongoDB-backed data persistence system.

features: AI Image Analyzer with Vision API
challenges: Implementing real-time streaming responses with SSE while maintaining conversation context across sessions.
Building a provider-agnostic AI abstraction layer that supports multiple LLM backends without rewriting core logic.
Handling multi-file uploads (CSV, XLSX, JSON), parsing them server-side, and generating structured AI insights with chart data.
solutions: Used Server-Sent Events with TanStack React Query for streaming, and stored full conversation history in MongoDB for persistent context.
Designed an AIProvider interface with a factory pattern, starting with OpenRouter and leaving clean extension points for Gemini, Claude, and others.
Built a Multer + PapaParse/SheetJS pipeline on the backend with Zod validation, sending parsed previews to GPT-4o for structured JSON analysis output.

title: GameDB – Game Discovery & Review Platform
description: A full-stack game discovery platform that connects gamers with their next favorite titles. Integrates the RAWG Video Games Database API to provide a rich catalog of games with details, screenshots, trailers, and ratings. Users can browse, search, review, and wishlist games, while writers can submit custom game entries. Administrators have full moderation and analytics capabilities.

challenges: Managing three distinct user roles (Visitor, User, Admin) with granular permissions and protecting routes accordingly.
Integrating RAWG API while handling rate limits, caching, and maintaining responsive search/filter functionality.
Building a custom game submission pipeline with image uploads, status workflows, and admin moderation.
solutions: Implemented NextAuth v5 middleware with JWT sessions and role-based route protection, including ban detection on every request.
Used Next.js ISR with 1-hour revalidation for RAWG API caching, combined with server-side pagination for efficient data loading.
Built ImageBB integration for image hosting, Mongoose status workflows (published/draft/pending/archived), and admin moderation dashboards.

title: Fable | E-book Digital Marketplace Platform
description: A full-stack e-book marketplace connecting readers, writers, and administrators. Writers publish and monetize original e-books, readers discover and purchase content, and admins manage the platform with analytics. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router) and Express.js 5, it features role-based authentication, Stripe payment integration, real-time dashboards with interactive charts, and a polished responsive UI with dark/light theming.

features: Writer Dashboard with Sales Analytics & Charts
Admin Dashboard with Revenue & User Growth Charts
challenges: Implementing role-based authentication and server-side route protection for three distinct user roles (reader, writer, admin) while maintaining a seamless UX across dashboards.
Integrating Stripe checkout sessions for e-book purchases with proper server-side session creation and post-purchase success handling.
Building separate analytics dashboards for each role with interactive charts (Recharts) showing sales history, revenue trends, and user growth over configurable time ranges.
solutions: Used BetterAuth with email/password and Google OAuth, combined with custom requireRole() middleware in Next.js layout files and Express.js server-side session helpers for secure route guards.
Created dedicated Stripe checkout session API routes on the Next.js server with @stripe/stripe-js client-side integration, handling redirects and success page rendering after payment confirmation.
Built role-specific dashboard components using Recharts for line charts and statistics cards, with server-side data fetching utilities (serverFetch, protectedFetch) and Server Actions for mutations.

title: MediQueue | Medical Tutoring Marketplace
description: A full-stack medical tutoring marketplace where students can browse expert medical tutors, book 1-on-1 sessions, and manage their learning schedules. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router) and Express.js, it features advanced tutor search with filters, JWT-protected booking system with slot management, Google OAuth authentication, and a polished responsive UI with dark/light mode.

features: Browse Tutors with Advanced Search & Filters
Tutor Detail Pages with Booking Widget
challenges: Implementing JWT-protected booking endpoints with asymmetric JWKS-based token verification using jose-cjs.
Building advanced tutor search with real-time debounced filtering across multiple fields (name, subject, institution).
Managing slot availability with atomic decrement operations on successful bookings.
solutions: Used jose-cjs createRemoteJWKSet to fetch JWKS from the Next.js client and verify tokens asymmetrically on the backend.
Created a custom useDebounce hook with 400ms delay, filtering tutors by name, subject, and institution via query parameters.
Implemented PATCH /tutors/:id/decrease-slot endpoint with MongoDB atomic operations to prevent overbooking.

title: KeenKeeper | Friend Interaction Dashboard
description: A modern friend interaction dashboard built with Next.js that helps you nurture and track your most meaningful relationships. It provides a visual overview of your social connections, interaction history, and analytics to ensure you never lose touch with the people who matter most.

features: Friend Analytics Dashboard with Interactive Pie Charts
Personal Relationship Manager with Dynamic Routes
Friend Status Tracking (On Track / Overdue / Almost Due)
challenges: Managing shared state for friends and interactions across multiple pages without a backend database.
Making the timeline filterable by interaction type while keeping the UI responsive and smooth.
Fetching friend data server-side for dynamic routes while maintaining client-side interaction state.
solutions: Used React Context API with localStorage persistence to share and store interaction data across all components.
Built a filter-based timeline component with a dropdown selector and conditional rendering for each interaction type.
Leveraged Next.js App Router with async server components for friend data fetching and client components for interaction logging.

title: SkillSphere | Online Skill Learning Platform
description: A modern full-stack e-learning platform built with Next.js 16 and React 19 that enables users to browse, discover, and enroll in courses across various skill categories. Features secure authentication with email/password and Google OAuth powered by Better Auth, dynamic course listings with search and filtering, user profile management, and a polished responsive UI with smooth Framer Motion animations. The platform uses MongoDB for data persistence and follows a server-first architecture with Next.js App Router.

features: Session-Based Auth with Better Auth & MongoDB
Detailed Course Pages with Instructor Info
User Profile Management with Image Update
challenges: Implementing session-based authentication with Better Auth and MongoDB while protecting specific routes via middleware.
Building a seamless responsive navigation experience with separate mobile drawer and desktop layouts.
Fetching and sorting course data server-side for popular (by rating) and trending (by learners) sections while keeping the client-side search performant.
solutions: Integrated Better Auth with a MongoDB adapter and Google OAuth social provider, using middleware to guard /profile and /all-courses routes.
Designed a dual-navigation system with a desktop Navbar and a slide-out mobile drawer, both sharing consistent styling with Tailwind and DaisyUI.
Used Next.js App Router server components to pre-sort courses by rating and learner count, then passed props to client components for interactive search with query parameter persistence.

title: DigiTools Platform | Digital Tools Buying Website
description: A responsive e-commerce-style product catalog and shopping cart website for digital tools. Users can browse 10 digital products (design tools, AI assistants, VPNs, etc.), view details and pricing, add items to a cart, remove items, and proceed to checkout. Built with React.js, styled with Tailwind CSS and DaisyUI, and features toast notifications for all cart actions.

features: Responsive Navbar with Cart Item Count
Add to Cart with Buy Now Button
Toast Notifications for All Cart Actions
challenges: Managing cart state across multiple components while keeping the UI in sync.
Building a toggleable main section that switches between product listing and cart view seamlessly.
Ensuring full responsiveness across all screen sizes for product cards, cart, and layout sections.
solutions: Used React state lifting and props to share cart data between Product and Cart components.
Implemented conditional rendering with state-driven toggle buttons for the main section.
Applied Tailwind CSS utility classes and DaisyUI components for a mobile-first responsive layout.

title: GitHub Issue Tracker
description: A client-side web application for tracking and managing GitHub issues. Features a login page with demo credentials, an issue dashboard with card-based UI, tab filtering (All/Open/Closed), real-time search, and a detail modal for viewing individual issues. Built with vanilla HTML, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript, fetching data from a remote API.

features: Issue Dashboard with Card Grid Layout
Issue Detail Modal with Full Info
challenges: Fetching and rendering dynamic issue data from a remote API endpoint.
Implementing real-time search that filters results while respecting the active tab filter.
Building a responsive card grid layout that adapts across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
solutions: Used the Fetch API with async/await to retrieve issue data and render cards dynamically with vanilla JavaScript.
Implemented a dual-filter approach where search results are further filtered by the current tab status.
Leveraged Tailwind CSS grid utilities (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) for responsive layouts.

title: Weather – Weather Forecast App
description: A clean, responsive weather forecast web application that fetches real-time and multi-day weather data for any city worldwide. Powered by the OpenWeatherMap API, it features city search with autocomplete, geolocation-based current location detection, hourly and 7-day forecasts, and a detailed weather metrics panel.

features: Real-Time City Weather Display with temperature, feels-like, and min/max
Hourly Forecast Strip with scrollable weather intervals
7-Day Detailed Forecast with weather icons and conditions
Weather Details Panel (Visibility, Humidity, Wind, Pressure, Sunrise/Sunset)
Day/Night Icon Logic based on forecast timestamp
Loading Skeleton Placeholders during data fetch
Server State Caching with TanStack React Query
challenges: Handling OpenWeatherMap API rate limits and ensuring smooth data fetching without excessive calls.
Designing a clean UI that works well on both desktop and mobile with horizontal scrollable forecast strips.
Implementing accurate day/night icon switching based on forecast timestamps.
solutions: Used TanStack React Query for intelligent caching and deduplication of API requests with configurable stale times.
Built a mobile-first responsive layout using Tailwind CSS with overflow scroll for forecast cards.
Created a utility function that checks forecast timestamps against 6 AM–6 PM window to swap icon suffixes between day and night variants.
